name: pcb_t
comment: main PCB thickness

name: plate_gap
comment: PCB top to plate bottom (top_case.scad wall_height for Choc v1)

name: plate_t
comment: switch plate (PCB) thickness

name: base_h
comment: bottom case height below the PCB

name: pocket_d
comment: component pocket depth in the case floor

name: pcb_clear
comment: clearance PCB-to-case wall and window-to-plate (SCAD 0.3 + 0.075 outline stroke)

name: wall
comment: bottom case outer wall thickness

name: lip_proud
comment: case window-lip ends stand this far proud of the outer wall (a lip end inside the wall fillet fails)

name: ledge_w
comment: width of the ledge the PCB rests on

name: fillet_r
comment: outer edge fillet of the bottom case

name: insert_d
comment: M2 heatset insert hole in the bottom case

name: win_hole_d
comment: center window mounting hole

name: bump_w
comment: center window bump width

name: top_overhang
comment: window bump overhang past the PCB centre section (front + back)

name: bump_fillet
comment: window bump top and corner fillet

name: win_base_t
comment: center window base thickness (as printed)

name: window_h
comment: window bump inner height above the window base bottom

name: thick
comment: center window shell thickness

name: cutout_z
comment: case wall cutouts start this far above the PCB bottom

name: term_cut_end
comment: terminal cutouts end this far past the last terminal pin (case + window)

name: case_term_start
comment: case terminal cutout starts this far before the first terminal pin

name: pwr_cut_w
comment: power switch cutout width (centred on its pins)

name: rst_cut_w
comment: reset button cutout width (centred on its outer pins)

name: case_cut_in
comment: case wall cutouts reach this far inside the PCB edge

name: case_cut_out
comment: case wall cutouts reach this far outside the PCB edge

name: win_term_start
comment: window terminal cutout starts this far before the first terminal pin

name: win_term_l
comment: window terminal cutout length from the PCB centre bottom edge

name: win_sw_past
comment: window power/reset cutouts reach this far past the PCB centre top edge

name: win_pwr_l
comment: window power switch cutout length

name: win_pwr_h
comment: window power switch cutout height above the window bottom

name: win_rst_l
comment: window reset button cutout length

name: win_rst_h
comment: window reset button cutout height above the window bottom

name: jst_cut_w
comment: JST connector cutout width (centred on its pins)

name: jst_cut_l
comment: JST connector cutout length

name: jst_cut_past
comment: JST cutout reaches this far past the JST pins (+y)

name: jst_cut_h
comment: JST cutout height above the window bottom

name: wire_cut_w
comment: battery wire channel width

name: wire_cut_l
comment: battery wire channel length (ends at the JST cutout)

name: wire_cut_dx
comment: wire channel centre sits this far -x of the JST pins centre

name: wire_cut_h
comment: wire channel height above the window bottom

name: cover_w
comment: wire cover bump width

name: cover_l
comment: wire cover bump length

name: cover_dx
comment: wire cover centre sits this far -x of the JST pins centre

name: cover_past
comment: wire cover reaches this far past the JST cutout bottom (+y)

name: cover_h
comment: wire cover height above the window base top

name: usbc_w
comment: USB-C opening width

name: usbc_h
comment: USB-C opening slot height

name: usbc_z
comment: upper USB-C slot centre above the window bottom

name: screen_w
comment: screen opening width

name: screen_l
comment: screen opening length

name: screen_top_l
comment: screen chamfer length at the top surface

name: scuf_w
comment: SCUF foot width

name: scuf_cc
comment: SCUF foot end-centre to end-centre length

name: scuf_depth
comment: SCUF foot recess depth

name: scuf_chamfer
comment: SCUF foot recess chamfer

name: scuf_top_dx
comment: top SCUF feet: x offset from the top index key centre hole (mirrored left/right)

name: scuf_top_dy
comment: top SCUF feet: y offset from the top index key centre hole

name: scuf_top_rot
comment: top SCUF feet angle (mirrored)

name: scuf_mid_rot
comment: middle SCUF feet angle (centred on the pinky home key centre hole)

name: scuf_bot_dx
comment: bottom SCUF feet: x offset from the thumb key centre hole (mirrored)

name: scuf_bot_dy
comment: bottom SCUF feet: y offset (below) the thumb key centre hole

name: scuf_bot_rot
comment: bottom SCUF feet angle (mirrored)

name: frame_x
comment: PCB Gerber x offset into the case frame (puts M2 holes on the case holes)

name: frame_y
comment: PCB Gerber y offset into the case frame

name: plate_l_x
comment: left plate Gerber x offset (holes on PCB holes)

name: plate_r_x
comment: right plate (turned over) x offset

name: plate_y
comment: plate Gerber y offset
